Definition: from G3415; a memorial, i.e. sepulchral monument (burial-place):--grave, sepulchre, tomb.
BiblicalUsage: Mnema is a tomb, a grave — the new tomb where Joseph lays the body of Jesus, the tomb the women find empty on the first day of the week, and the tombs among which the possessed man of Gadara lives.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word gathers the whole gospel into one place: a man living among the dead, and a dead man who leaves His tomb empty.
RelatedEvents: The Burial of Jesus; The Resurrection
